item.title: Monitoring Depression Relapse With a Wearable #WearableWednesday
item.description: Researchers at McMaster University collected sleep and activity data from 93 adults across Canada who had previously recovered from depression. Utilizing a research-grade actigraphy wearable device, over 32,000 days of data was generated. Their research was published in JAMA Psychiatry. The new research highlights a simple, yet powerful way to passively monitor relapse risk in […]
